attestations.note: The life page `/3614/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole content besides the lexicon gloss of the name is «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου». No years, no places, no hymn, and therefore no `dates` object and no `locations`. He is none of the twelve Neophytos folders the corpus holds, whose Greek days are elsewhere. The page's only navigation link is to «Άγιος Αρτέμιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας ο Σιναΐτης», the corpus's `artemius-the-sinaite`, whose Greek feast is 6 February; that is the site's own furniture and not a sentence of this life, so no `related` row is made from it. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
